issue_context.title: Vim normal mode cursor behaves differently when inlay hints are enabled
issue_context.body:
### Summary

With an inlay hint at the end of a line, pressing `$` to navigate to the end of the line causes the cursor to be placed one column to the right of where it would usually be placed.  This causes things like `a` to start inserting at the beginning of the next line instead of at the end of the current line:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3b7587fd-e72d-4071-8d4e-356cbcf04ae8

### Zed Version and System Specs

Zed: v0.172.0 (Zed Dev)
OS: Linux X11 ubuntu 24.04
Memory: 125.4 GiB
Architecture: x86_64
GPU: NVIDIA RTX 5000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU || NVIDIA || 550.120
